column4: prone to certain behaviours duplicates the sense "susceptible" already listed for vatbaar.
Duplicates the other meaning 'prudish', which is essentially the same sense as 'prim'.
Bescheidenheid means modesty; 'small gift' is not a meaning of this word (it confuses it with 'attentie' or 'bescheiden' usage).
De kauw is the jackdaw itself, not its call, so this meaning does not exist and the jackdaw sense is already listed.
Lodewijk does not mean London; it is the Dutch form of Louis, which is already listed as another meaning.
Quacksalver is just a synonym of quack and duplicates the other meaning.
'Hollen' does not mean 'to hollow out' (that is 'uithollen'); the meaning does not exist for this word.
In chess the piece is called loper; raadsheer as bishop is an obscure, old or Belgian usage that would only confuse learners.
West Indies is West-Indië, not plain Indië, so this meaning does not exist for this word.
Verwezen is a participle of verwijzen (to refer), and 'to orphan' is not a real verb meaning; the adjective sense 'orphaned' is already covered by item 3.
Crediting something to someone's merit is the same as the 'hold accountable' sense (positive or negative), and is marked archaic, so it only duplicates.
A koker is not a cooking device; this meaning does not exist and the tube meaning is already listed.
lauw does not mean "nice"; its real senses (lukewarm, half-hearted) are already listed.
It duplicates the 'female fraudster' meaning of the same word.
The meaning 'to seize' is not a normal sense of aanhalen (arresting is aanhouden), so the example is wrong and the sense does not exist.
'Fondle' is an obscure, archaic sense (zich vleien, neervleien means to nestle), which would only confuse a learner.
'To form a membrane' is not a real meaning of vleien, apparently a confusion with the noun vlies.
'Kuis' does not mean pig (that is a confusion with 'kuit' or 'zeug'), so this meaning does not exist.
To be ailing is essentially the same meaning as "to be wrong (with)", as in 'Wat mankeert je?', so it duplicates another meaning.
It duplicates the gadfly meaning, which already covers the idiom, so this separate sense is redundant.

Kinderlijk is an adjective (childlike), not a noun for a child's corpse (that would be "kinderlijkje"/"kinderlijk" is not standard), and it is the only meaning listed, so it is better to fix it: but the noun meaning is invented; however the rule forbids dropping the only meaning.
This meaning only repeats the existing 'to inhale' meaning.
'To brush' is essentially a repeat of the 'to sweep'/'to clean' senses of vagen, so it adds nothing.
'Ornithorhynchid' is a technical duplicate of the platypus meaning, which is the one learners need.
Obscure and unreliable meaning that overlaps with the other 'mud' senses; 'mud' as a land measure is archaic and confusing, so drop it.
The 'small measure for liquids' sense is dubious and duplicates the old measure of volume sense, so drop it.
babbling and "babble" are the same meaning, so this duplicates the other entry.
luit means lute; lieutenant is not a Dutch meaning of this word (it is "luitenant"), so the entry is wrong.
The rare 'act' sense of ligging does not really exist; the word means position or location, which is already listed.
Duplicates the other meaning 'barrage of suppressive crossfire'.
Sticht means a bishopric or religious foundation, not simply a monastery, so this is an obscure and misleading archaic sense.
Beggar is not a real meaning of zwabber (it is a mop or a sloppy/dissolute person), so this sense is invalid.
Duplicates the other 'dirtbag' meaning of the same word, so it is redundant.
'dradenstoffer m' is an untranslated obscure Dutch description of the mop meaning, which is already listed, so it only duplicates and confuses.
Zwabber meaning 'tail of a fish' does not exist in standard Dutch and is not among the real meanings.
The 'tramp' meaning is a near-duplicate of the existing 'dirty person' and 'dirtbag' senses and is obscure.
Symboliek is a noun, not an adjective; the adjective meaning is wrong (the adjective is symbolisch) and the noun is listed separately.
Aves is a Latin taxonomic term, not a useful English gloss, and the meaning duplicates 'fowl' (poultry/birds).
This is the same meaning as the other entry, an exclamation of surprise, so it is a duplicate.
Graceful is not really what behendig means and largely duplicates the existing "nimble" and "skillful" meanings.
The 'physics branch' meaning duplicates the other meaning 'acoustics'.
The two senses of laks (negligent and not strict) are practically the same, so this one duplicates item 2.
To dirty is the main meaning, and the "to sully" entry elsewhere is a near-duplicate; this item repeats it.
Dutch 'rumoer' means noise/commotion, not rumor, so this meaning does not exist and the noise meaning is already listed.
The 'gentile' sense is essentially the same as 'pagan' (non-Jewish, non-Christian) and is obscure, so it duplicates the pagan meaning.
The gloss 'specifically' is meaningless and the entry duplicates the language meaning of item 1.
Someone who runs is not a real meaning of voorloper, which means forerunner/precursor, already listed as another meaning.
This duplicates the other meaning, since military machine and war machine are the same sense.
'To close off with barriers' is essentially the same as the other meaning 'to enclose' (afperken/perken), so it is a duplicate.
Transport is not what mobiliteit means here; the sense is covered by the other meaning 'mobility', so this duplicates it.
The 'depression in stone' sense is a lunar/geological term that is obscure for learners, and the entry already lists other meanings such as nightmare and rumor.
'Dutch' is not a meaning of toko; it comes from the Indonesian-Dutch context and is wrongly listed, and it has no example.
This duplicates the existing 'flail' meaning (weapon and whipping implement) already listed, and the threshing sense is the same as the first gloss.

column3: weapon with a weight on a chain
column4: This duplicates the flail meaning, since a flail with a ball on a chain is just the spiked flail weapon sense, and the example is the same as the flail entry.
A vlegel is not a whip, so this meaning is invalid and the example does not fit; the real tool sense (a threshing flail) is already covered by the flail entry.
Opwaartse kracht means both lift and buoyancy, so this meaning duplicates the other one.
'Monster' is a weak, near-duplicate sense of creature; the entry's general meaning already covers it and it would confuse learners since 'monster' has its own word.
'Helpful' is a wrong meaning for the noun toeverlaat and duplicates the 'mainstay/support' sense in the other entry.
'other obstacle' is not a real meaning of bruggenhoofd; it is a bogus entry.
Any vulture duplicates the other meaning "vulture", so it is redundant.
The figurative meaning (ill-conceived) is what learners need, but this entry's gloss duplicates the literal 'half-baked' sense; the other meaning covers the same word, so this repeat is dropped.
Ratel for honeycomb is a rare dialect/obscure sense (honingraat is the normal word) and would only confuse learners.
Both 'to coagulate' and 'to solidify' are the same meaning of stollen (to set/congeal), so this duplicates the other meaning.
'Stilt' is not a meaning of schaats; the only real meaning, skate, is already listed.
'Land route' is a vague duplicate of the same 'landweg' meaning, but here the gloss 'rural road' is the better one, so this item duplicates the other meaning and should be dropped.
'Buil' means a bump, bruise or boil, and 'large' is not a meaning of this noun.
'Small' is not a meaning of the noun 'buil'; the real meanings are bruise and boil, which are listed already.
Verassen means to cremate; incinerating waste is a rare extension that duplicates the cremate meaning and would confuse learners.
Bekogelen does not mean 'to besiege'; it means to pelt, so this meaning does not exist.
Bekogelen does not mean 'to delude'; the meaning does not exist.
'Clutter in milk' is not a real meaning of trombose; it is nonsense.
Trombose means thrombosis, and 'thrombus' (bloedprop) is not a separate sense, so it duplicates the main meaning.
'To excuse' is not a real meaning of verbloemen; it is covered by 'to mask' and 'to veil'.
Personify is not a meaning of verbloemen (that is personifiëren), and the real senses (to veil, mask, excuse) are already listed.
'In het abuis zijn' is just the same noun meaning 'mistake' as the first entry, so this duplicates it.
'To swindle' is not a real meaning of bekopen; the verb means to pay for something with a penalty, or occasionally to buy off, so this entry is wrong.
Heldhaftigheid means the quality of heroism, and the 'heroic feat' sense is not a separate meaning (that would be heldendaad), so it is a near-duplicate of the other entry.
